mapper.select: SELECT id, title, author, description, encoding, chapter_count, volume_count, character_count, '' AS preface, sha256, catalog_published, text_published, created_at, timeline_date, cover_path FROM books catalog_published = TRUE ORDER BY created_at DESC, id

SELECT id, title, author, description, encoding, chapter_count, volume_count, character_count, preface, sha256, catalog_published, text_published, created_at, timeline_date, cover_path FROM books WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO books (id, title, author, description, encoding, chapter_count, volume_count, character_count, preface, sha256, catalog_published, text_published, created_at, timeline_date, cover_path) VALUES (#{id}, #{title}, #{author}, #{description}, #{encoding}, #{chapterCount}, #{volumeCount}, #{characterCount}, #{preface}, #{sha256}, #{catalogPublished}, #{textPublished}, #{createdAt}, #{timelineDate}, #{coverPath})
mapper.update: UPDATE books SET cover_path = #{coverPath} WHERE id = #{id}
